title: What Consumers Pay for National Pricing: Socialised Redispatch Expenditure on the GB Scotland-England Boundary - replication code and data
description: Replication code and data for the paper. Formalises GB electricity arrangements as a two-stage market (a network-blind national clearing followed by a cost-minimising redispatch) and measures, directly from public Balancing Mechanism settlement records, the realised redispatch expenditure on the Scotland-England (B6) boundary: GBP 1.18bn in FY 2024/25 (about 62% of GB's system constraint cost), computed for all 365 settlement days, with the multi-year trend for FY 2022/23 and FY 2023/24. Includes the optimisation models (nodal DCOPF benchmark, network-blind clearing, redispatch), the empirical pipeline over the key-free Elexon BMRS Insights and NESO Data Portal APIs, and one-command reproduction of every table and figure. This version (v0.2.0) accompanies the Energy Policy submission and supersedes v0.1.0 (Energy Economics submission); the headline is now the full-year direct measure rather than a 30-day stratified estimate.
